tasks.title: Create model and deploy web-service
tasks.instructions:
Create a new model named `lab-secrets` and deploy the `ubuntu` charm with alias `web-service`:

```bash
juju add-model lab-secrets
juju deploy ubuntu web-service --channel latest/stable
```

Verify that `web-service` exists:

```bash
juju status
```

tasks.title: Create managed secret
tasks.instructions:
Add a managed user secret named `app-token` with content `token=supersecret123`:

```bash
juju add-secret app-token token=supersecret123
```

Verify that the secret is listed:

```bash
juju list-secrets
```

tasks.title: Grant secret to web-service
tasks.instructions:
Grant read access on secret `app-token` to application `web-service`:

```bash
juju grant-secret app-token web-service
```

Verify secret access permissions:

```bash
juju show-secret app-token --reveal
```
